name: Falling Waters State Park
coordinateNote: Entrance or parking coordinates from the November 12, 2026 gap review.
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Walk the Sinkhole Trail boardwalk past fern-lined sinkholes to overlooks above and into Falling Waters Sink, then loop the short Wiregrass Trail. There is a small swimming lake and a full-hookup campground. The fall is rain-fed, so flow varies; call before driving out.
access: 8 a.m. to sunset, 365 days a year; walk-in day use, single-use day pass can also be bought online. Pets allowed except on the sinkhole/waterfall boardwalks. Park phone 850-638-6130 for current waterfall flow.

conditions.summary: Not on the Florida State Parks Hurricane Isaias closure list (effective Nov 1, 2026 the only closed park is Blackwater Heritage State Trail). Waterfall flow depends on recent rain, so it can be a trickle in a dry late fall. (source dated read 2026-11-12)
